caption: The drawing depicts a circular lace doily with intricate and detailed patterns. The doily has a tightly woven, light-colored center with a fine crisscross texture. Encircling the center is a band of denser, slightly darker lacework forming a wide border, which radiates outward with elaborate, delicate, and irregularly shaped motifs resembling floral or organic forms. The lace border features clustered, textured elements interspersed with open spaces, giving a lacy, airy appearance. The artwork is rendered in shades of gray to black on a plain, off-white background, emphasizing the complexity of the lace. The drawing is signed “Frank J. Nelson” in the bottom right corner.
title: Doily
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
